question:
Select the word from among the given options that is closest in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

Puja decided to __**devote**__ more time to volunteering at the local shelter, helping those in need.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dedicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Devote"** means to give all or a large part of one's time or resources to a person, activity, or cause. (समर्पित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to devote his weekends to learning a new language.
 
 
 
• **"Dedicate"** refers to committing time, effort, or oneself to a specific purpose, cause, or activity. (समर्पण करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She dedicated her life to teaching underprivileged children.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Dedicate" is the word closest in meaning to "Devote."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dedicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Divide** (विभाजित करना): To separate into parts or groups.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher divided the class into small groups for the activity.
 
 
 
• **Waste** (व्यर्थ करना): To use something carelessly or without purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** He wasted his money on unnecessary items.
 
 
 
• **Plan** (योजना बनाना): To think about and arrange the details of something beforehand.
 
 
• **Example:** They planned their vacation months in advance.
